category: Agent document runtime — flow documents only (not OCR suites, not office GUIs)
north_star: A stranger opening github.com/kevin9327/docagent must immediately see what DocAgent does, with hero art, a capability matrix, and real outputs, at the visual density of MinerU/Docling/Pandoc. First screen: determinism + capsule + GPU-free. DocAgent wins the agent-runtime axes: Command/Query/Event, capsule hashes, integer layout, byte-identical reruns, GPU-free convert, Hangul as a regional codec.

hangul: CHAR_SHAPE bold/italic/underline/super/sub on HWP5, HWPX hh:charPr, HML CHARSHAPE, HWP3 attr bits
strike on HWP5/HWPX/HML (HWP3 has no strike bit)
hyperlinks: HWP5 %hlk, HWPX fieldBegin HYPERLINK, HML FIELDBEGIN Hyperlink, HWP3 control-10 + TagID 3
images: PNG and JPEG on Markdown, HTML, PDF/A, DOCX, ODT
HTML read of (Pandoc-class import, not HTML5, no http src)
examples/letter.md fixture has no image — convert shots must not pretend otherwise
